instruction.name: xvslt.hu
instruction.description: Compare the unsigned 16-bit elements in `a` and `b`, store all-ones to `dst` if corresponding element in `a` is less than `b`, zero otherwise.

experiments.name: dependent vector chain
experiments.notes: Consecutive unrolled copies form a vector-register dependency chain. Measured with unroll=100000 to amortise call overhead.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: xvslt.hu $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvslt.hu $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvslt.hu $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvslt.hu $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvslt.hu $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvslt.hu $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvslt.hu $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvslt.hu $xr7, $xr15, $xr23

throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --reps 7 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr8, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr9, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr10, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr11, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr12, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr13, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr14, $r4; li.d $r4, 1; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr15, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr16, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr17, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr18, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr19, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr20, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr21, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr22, $r4; li.d $r4, 2; xvreplgr2vr.b $xr23, $r4' --asm 'xvslt.hu $xr0, $xr8, $xr16; xvslt.hu $xr1, $xr9, $xr17; xvslt.hu $xr2, $xr10, $xr18; xvslt.hu $xr3, $xr11, $xr19; xvslt.hu $xr4, $xr12, $xr20; xvslt.hu $xr5, $xr13, $xr21; xvslt.hu $xr6, $xr14, $xr22; xvslt.hu $xr7, $xr15, $xr23'
